en: Sepia-toned wartime postcard showing heavily bombed and ruined buildings along a cobblestone street. Rubble fills the foreground, with several people standing among the debris. The printed German caption at the top right identifies the scene as destruction in Mitau, and there is a handwritten correction changing the word 'Kirche' (church) to 'Strasse' (street).
